```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
```
```{r}
tss <- read.csv("TSS Comparison.csv")
clr <- read.csv("CLR Comparison.csv")
logtss <- read.csv("logTSS Comparison.csv")
pa <- read.csv("PA Comparison.csv")

# Define custom colors
colors <- c(
  "Boosting" = "blue",
  "LogisticRegression" = "grey",
  "RandomForest" = "red",
  "SVM" = "skyblue",
  "KNN" = "yellow"
)

# Convert all datasets to long format
tss_long <- tss %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Dataset, names_to = "Classifier", values_to = "Performance") %>%
  mutate(Normalization = "RA")

clr_long <- clr %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Dataset, names_to = "Classifier", values_to = "Performance") %>%
  mutate(Normalization = "CLR")

logtss_long <- logtss %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Dataset, names_to = "Classifier", values_to = "Performance") %>%
  mutate(Normalization = "logRA")

pa_long <- pa %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Dataset, names_to = "Classifier", values_to = "Performance") %>%
  mutate(Normalization = "PA")

all_data <- bind_rows(tss_long, clr_long, logtss_long, pa_long)
all_data$Normalization <- factor(all_data$Normalization, levels = c("RA", "CLR", "logRA", "PA"))

norm_colors <- c("RA" = "#2a78b4", "CLR" = "#f0c042", "logRA" = "#8c8c8c", "PA" = "#c85c57")

classifier_colors <- c(
  "Boosting" = "blue",
  "LogisticRegression" = "grey",
  "RandomForest" = "red",
  "SVM" = "skyblue",
  "KNN" = "yellow"
)


main_title <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label("", 
             fontface = "bold", size = 18, x = 0, hjust = 0) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 10, 7))  # Espaciado inferior

# 2(A): Overall Performance
p_top <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Normalization, y = Performance, fill = Normalization)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, width = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = norm_colors) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "Overall performance",
    x = "",
    y = "Performance (AUC)",
    fill = "Normalization"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# 3. (B): Breakdown by Classifier
p_bottom <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Normalization, y = Performance, fill = Classifier)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.8),
              alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = classifier_colors) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "Performance breakdown by classifier",
    x = "Normalization",
    y = "Performance (AUC)",
    fill = "Classifier"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

annotated_panel <- ggarrange(p_top, p_bottom,
                             ncol = 1, nrow = 2,
                             labels = c("A", "B"),
                             font.label = list(size = 14, face = "bold"),
                             align = "v",
                             heights = c(1.2, 1.8)
)

final_plot <- plot_grid(main_title, annotated_panel, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))

print(final_plot)
```

```{r}
friedman.test(as.matrix(df_pivot[, 3:6]))
```

```{r}
  # Preparar los datos para ggpubr
df_rf <- data.frame(
  Method = rep(c("RA", "CLR", "logRA", "PA"), each = nrow(tss)),
  Performance = c(tss$RandomForest, clr$RandomForest, logtss$RandomForest, pa$RandomForest)
)

df_lr <- data.frame(
  Method = rep(c("RA", "CLR", "logRA", "PA"), each = nrow(tss)),
  Performance = c(tss$LogisticRegression, clr$LogisticRegression, logtss$LogisticRegression, pa$LogisticRegression)
)

df_cross <- data.frame(
  Method = rep(c("RA+RF", "CLR+LR", "logRA+LR", "PA+RF"), each = nrow(tss)),
  Performance = c(tss$RandomForest, clr$LogisticRegression, logtss$LogisticRegression, pa$RandomForest)
)
common_ylim <- c(0.52, 0.94)
# Graficar Random Forest
rf_plot <- ggboxplot(
  df_rf, x = "Method", y = "Performance", fill = "Method",
  palette = "jco", add = "jitter", title = "Random Forest Comparison"
) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(y = "Performance (AUC)", x = "")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = common_ylim)

# Graficar Logistic Regression
lr_plot <- ggboxplot(
  df_lr, x = "Method", y = "Performance", fill = "Method",
  palette = "jco", add = "jitter", title = "Logistic Regression Comparison"
) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  
  labs(y = "Performance (AUC)", x = "")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = common_ylim)

# Comparación cruzada
cross_plot <- ggboxplot(
  df_cross, x = "Method", y = "Performance", fill = "Method",
  palette = "jco", add = "jitter", title = "Cross Comparison (Best Classifiers)"
) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  
  labs(y = "Performance (AUC)", x = "")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = common_ylim)


combined_plot <- (rf_plot | lr_plot | cross_plot) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') & 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",   # Aquí se quita la leyenda
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.03, 0.98),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

df_rf <- df_rf %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
df_widerf <- df_rf %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = Performance)
friedman.test(as.matrix(df_widerf[, -1])) 

df_lr <- df_lr %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
df_widelr <- df_lr %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = Performance)
friedman.test(as.matrix(df_widelr[, -1])) 


df_cross <- df_cross %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Pivotamos
df_wide <- df_cross %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = Performance)
  
friedman.test(as.matrix(df_wide[, -1]))  
# Mostrar los gráficos
print(combined_plot)
```
```{r}
rarefactions <- read.csv("Rarefaction Comparison.csv")
normalizations <- unique(rarefactions$Normalization)

for (norm in normalizations) {
  cat("\n\n--- Normalization:", norm, "---\n")

  df <- subset(rarefactions, Normalization == norm)

  none <- subset(df, Method == "None")
  rare <- subset(df, Method == "Rare")
  rareq5 <- subset(df, Method == "RareQ5")

    cat("None vs Rare:\n")
    print(wilcox.test(none$AUC, rare$AUC, paired = TRUE))
    
    cat("None vs RareQ5:\n")
    print(wilcox.test(none$AUC, rareq5$AUC, paired = TRUE))
    
    cat("Rare vs RareQ5:\n")
    print(wilcox.test(rare$AUC, rareq5$AUC, paired = TRUE))
  
}
common_ylim <- c(min(rarefactions$AUC), max(rarefactions$AUC))

# Initialize an empty list to store ggplot objects
plot_list <- list()

for (norm in normalizations) {
  # Subset data for this normalization
  df_norm <- subset(rarefactions, Normalization == norm)
  
  # Create the ggboxplot for the current normalization
  p <- ggboxplot(
    df_norm,
    x = "Method",
    y = "AUC",
    fill = "Method",
    palette = "jco", # Using the 'jco' palette as in your example
    add = "jitter",
    title = paste("Normalization:", norm)
  ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none", # Remove legend for individual plots
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5) # Center plot title
    ) +
    labs(y = "Performance (AUC)", x = "") + # Y-axis label and empty X-axis label
    scale_y_continuous(limits = common_ylim) # Apply common Y-axis limit
  
  # Add the plot to the list
  plot_list[[norm]] <- p
}

  if (length(plot_list) == 4) {
    combined_plot <- (plot_list[[1]] | plot_list[[2]]) / (plot_list[[3]] | plot_list[[4]]) +
      plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') &
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.03, 0.98),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
      )
  } else {
    # For a variable number of plots, wrap_plots is more flexible
    combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2) + # Adjust ncol as needed
      plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') &
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.tag.position = c(0.03, 0.98),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
      )
  }
  
  # Print the combined plot
  print(combined_plot)
```

```{r}
cfs <- read.csv("CombinedFS.csv")

cfs_long <- cfs %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(RA, CLR, logRA, PA),
    names_to = "Normalization",
    values_to = "Performance"
  )

cfs_long$Normalization <- factor(cfs_long$Normalization, levels = c("RA", "CLR", "logRA", "PA"))

my_colors <- c("RA" = "#2a78b4", "CLR" = "#f0c042", "logRA" = "#8c8c8c", "PA" = "#c85c57")


FSFRIED <- ggplot(cfs_long, aes(x = Normalization, y = Performance, fill = Normalization)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE, outlier.shape = NA) +  
  geom_jitter(color = "black", width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +  
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Performance (AUC)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12), legend.position = "none"
  )

```


```{r}
# Filtrar datos CLR
clrfs <- read.csv("NestedCLRFeatureSelectionFINAL.csv")[c("Dataset", "Model", "FS_Method", "AUC")]


# Crear una matriz con filas = datasets y columnas = modelos
df_wide <- clrfs %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Model,       # Las columnas nuevas se crean con los nombres de Model
    values_from = AUC         # Los valores que se colocan en esas columnas vienen de AUC
  )

# Aplicar el test de Friedman
ftt <- friedman.test(as.matrix(df_wide[c(-1, -2)]))
print(ftt$p.value)
```


```{r}
lrfs <- clrfs %>%
  filter(Model == "LogisticRegression") %>%
  mutate(FS_Method = reorder(FS_Method, AUC, FUN = median))


colores_personalizados <- c(
  "LASSO"     = "#7979c7",
  "AE50"      = "#FFD700",
  "AE100"     = "#377eb8",
  "VAE"       = "#999999",
  "MRMR50"    = "#000000",
  "MRMR100"   = "#8b0000",
  "MIFS50"    = "#1414b8",
  "MIFS100"   = "#8f7700",
  "Relief50"  = "#e41a1c",
  "Relief100" = "#87CEEB",
  "RF50"      = "#90EE90",  # Verde claro y brillante (LightGreen)
  "RF100"     = "#228B22"   # Verde bosque oscuro (ForestGreen)
)


fsp <- ggplot(lrfs, aes(x = FS_Method, y = AUC, fill = FS_Method)) +
  
  # Boxplot con un borde negro para mejor contraste y sin outliers
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.9, color = "black") +
  
  # Jitter con puntos oscuros para que resalten sobre cualquier color
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, color = "black") +
  
  # Aplicar la paleta de colores personalizada
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colores_personalizados,
    name = "Method"  # <-- Aquí cambiamos el título de la leyenda
  ) +
  
  # Etiquetas y títulos
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Feature Selection Method",
    y = "Performance (AUC)"
  ) +
  
  # Tema minimalista y personalizado
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  
  # Cambiamos la posición de la leyenda y ajustamos su estilo
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),  # <- puedes ajustar también el estilo del título
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

auc_matrix <- lrfs %>%
  select(Dataset, FS_Method, AUC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = FS_Method, values_from = AUC)

# Quitar la columna Dataset para la prueba Friedman
auc_values <- as.matrix(auc_matrix[,-1])

friedman.test(auc_values)
```
